answer: Every claim climbs the karst of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the forge re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the wander of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
